Private Function Column(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal address As String) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range(address)
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    Column = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String, ByVal n As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:="High,Medium,Low"
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\text.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlDescending, CustomOrder:="High,Medium,Low"
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\down.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:="High, Medium,Low"
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\spaced.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:=n + 1
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\number.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1:A5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("Wed", "Sunday", "Mon", "sat", "Tue"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A5"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:=1
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A5")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A5")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\days.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:="High,Medium,Low"
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.MatchCase = True
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\case.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("A1"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=n + 2, MatchCase:=True
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\range_case.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("A1"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=n + 2
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\range.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1:B3").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array("x", "y", "z")))
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "t1"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 7
        ws.Range("A3").Value = "t3"
        Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("A1:A3")
        ws.Range("C1").Value = Join(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount), "|")
        ws.Range("C2").Value = Application.CustomListCount - n
        Tried = Column(ws, "C1:C2")
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:=""
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1:A7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("A1:A7"), Order:=xlAscending, CustomOrder:=n + 50
        ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:A7")
        ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
        ws.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Column(ws, "A1:A7")
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long, n As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    n = Application.CustomListCount
    Application.AddCustomList Array("Low", "Medium", "High")
    For i = 0 To 10
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder, n)
    Next
    For i = Application.CustomListCount To n + 1 Step -1
        Application.DeleteCustomList i
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
